name: What should homeowners prepare before a basement trim contractor arrives?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners prepare before a basement trim contractor arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a trim contractor arrives, verify that all drywall sanding, primer coats, and flooring installations are finished. Clear personal belongings, storage boxes, and furniture at least three to four feet away from all walls and doorways so carpenters have clear work lanes for miter saws and nail guns. If you have leftover flooring scraps, keep them accessible so the installer can verify thickness tolerances against door jambs and transitions before cutting trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all walls and door openings, ensure flooring and drywall are complete, and keep flooring scraps handy for jamb height matching.
